name: Hang Duong cemetery
summary: Walk here after the camps. The cemetery is about 20 hectares, restoration started on 19 December 1992, and it is not the prison. Võ Thị Sáu’s grave is in zone B. The vigil on 23 January 2026 was at 09:00. Ordinary hours and a separate ticket are Check on arrival.
getThere: In town. A street number for the gate was not printed.
heroCaption: The monument, the trees, and the ridge. The monument does not mark a grave zone.

notice.title: This is not the Vũng Tàu memorial
notice.body: The vigil is at the grave in Hàng Dương, on the island. The memorial of Võ Thị Sáu in Vũng Tàu is a different place.

body: You walk the cemetery of the prison, not the camps themselves. The history-museum chapter gives about 20 hectares and restoration from 19 December 1992, in four zones. Zone A has 688 graves, 7 of them mass, and 91 named. Zone B has 695 graves, 17 mass, and 276 named, including Võ Thị Sáu. Zone C has 373 graves, 1 mass, and 332 named. Zone D has 157 graves and 14 named, gathered from Hòn Cau and Hàng Keo. The monument and the trees do not mark which zone you are in.

The ceremonial gate has pillars, a tiled roof, and the ridge. It does not mark a zone either. The 74th memorial was 22–23 January 2026. The vigil at the grave was 09:00 on 23 January 2026, then the rite at Đền thờ Côn Đảo. The special-zone office on Nguyễn Văn Linh, khu 6, is the office, not the temple door.
Ordinary hours were not printed. A separate cemetery ticket was not printed. Both are Check on arrival. Do not put this stop on the same plan as the Vũng Tàu memorial.
